answer: Sybil tax: each identity locks 70 credits, pays 45 per timber voyage from basalt quarry. Each voyage carries one timber load; its manifest is key-signed and logged. Auditors replay the ledger each epoch; a reused manifest or shared voyage burns the bond. No bulk discount: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 an epoch and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented voyage fails: each manifest binds one key to one load. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep the bond.
